goal: faithful gemma-4-31B speculative decoding measurement (output-lossless serving acceleration)
environment: user authorized freeing GPU; stopped gpt-oss (8006) + kanana (8020) -> GPU1 ~100GB free; served gemma-4-31B on a dedicated slice; production models stopped were restarted and verified healthy afterward

baseline_gemma31b_no_spec.note: confirms the orchestrator is decode-bound at ~50 tok/s on a dedicated slice, matching the earlier 53 tok/s figure

blocker.draft_model_spec: vLLM 0.19 raises NotImplementedError: 'Speculative Decoding with draft models or parallel drafting does not support multimodal models yet'. gemma-4 (31B and E4B) are multimodal (Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration), so a gemma-4-E4B draft is rejected.
blocker.ngram_spec: the no-draft alternative (prompt-lookup) requires numba, which is broken in the production venv (numba needs NumPy <= 2.2, venv has 2.4); the shared production venv was not modified.

conclusion: The output-lossless serving lever (speculative decoding) is NOT available for this specific orchestrator with the current stack: draft-model spec is unsupported for the gemma-4 multimodal model, and n-gram spec is blocked by the venv's numba/NumPy incompatibility. Enabling it would require either a text-only orchestrator, an EAGLE/MTP head trained for gemma-4, or fixing numba (NumPy downgrade) in an isolated/upgraded environment to use n-gram prompt-lookup (which suits the structured JSON stages). GPU capacity was NOT the limiting factor.
production_impact: gpt-oss and kanana were down for the experiment window (~15 min) and restarted with identical commands/env; all 8 vLLM endpoints + litellm verified 200 afterward.
